messages:
maria: Starting follow-up tracker for the vendor/dependency outage postmortem. Need owners, timelines, and quick mitigations for cloud region flaps, model-registry DB overloads, and auth-provider throttling.

dave: Agree. We should mark any infra automation that affects traffic as sprint-next unless it's P0.

leila: Product observed ~40% elevated errors for Dedicated customers during the incident window. We need comms + mitigations prioritized.

samir: SRE recap: sequence was cloud networking instability -> uneven load consolidation -> model-registry DB pool exhaustion -> retries to auth provider -> auth vendor throttling.

jess: Security: token introspection failures amplified latency. Short-term: local caching + bounded retries. Long-term: reduce on-path auth dependency.

maria: Proposed actions:
- V1: Cross-region traffic-shift automation + monthly failover drill. owner: dave. due: 2026-04-02. ticket: ENG-3501.
- V2: Model-registry fallback to object-store + per-model circuit breakers. owner: samir. due: 2026-04-09. ticket: ENG-3510.
- V3: Auth resilience: local token cache (10s TTL) + jittered backoff + vendor escalation. owner: jess. due: 2026-03-31. ticket: SEC-412.
- V4: Retry-policy audit & safe defaults doc. owner: leila. due: 2026-04-05. ticket: ENG-3522.
- V5: Customer comms + Dedicated SLA review. owner: kevin. due: 2026-03-29. ticket: OPS-999.

dave: I accept V1. Plan: env-level health tags + manual prototype cutover, then automate. Will include cost estimate.

samir: I accept V2. Notes: snapshot models to object-store every 10m; serve read-only copies if DB pool >80% for >90s. Add per-model token-bucket limits.

jess: I accept V3. Filed vendor case #AV-7004. Will add metrics and local cache, and a bulkhead for token calls.

leila: I accept V4. Audit will find common retry anti-patterns and propose a shared client with safe defaults.

kevin: I accept V5. CS will draft proactive templates and Ops will review SLA wording.

infra-bot: Created tickets ENG-3501, ENG-3510, ENG-3522. Linked runbook: https://git.redwood/sre/runbooks/vendor-mitigations.md

maria: Prioritization: V3 and V1 are P0. V2 and V4 are P1. V5 handled in parallel by CS.

dave: I'll add cost/benefit into ENG-3501 by 2026-03-28 for budget approval.

samir: Note: our retry spike pattern amplifies vendor throttles. ENG-3522 should include circuit-breaker defaults and avoid unbounded retries.

jess: Suggest adding a vendor-incident model tag so registry can auto-throttle hot models during vendor issues.

maria: Follow-up sync scheduled Tue 2026-03-30 16:00 UTC. Post short status updates in this thread (PRs, ticket links, vendor case numbers). Marking postmortem status: in progress.

pagerbot: Reminder set for 2026-03-30 16:00:00 UTC.
